edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender of the ERC20 transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender for the allowance deduction in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the `from` address in _transfer and is compared against owner() to gate fee/limit logic.
setCooldownEnabled is protected by onlyOwner which compares _owner to _msgSender().
removeLimits is protected by onlyOwner.
changeMaxTxAmount is protected by onlyOwner.
changeMaxWalletSize is protected by onlyOwner.
openTrading is protected by onlyOwner and performs privileged initialization.
nonosquare is protected by onlyOwner and can blacklist arbitrary addresses.
delBot is protected by onlyOwner.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet.
cooldown[to] is compared against and set from block.timestamp, making the anti-whale check miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
transfer forwards to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom forwards to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom decrements allowance through _approve.
balanceOf converts reflections using tokenFromReflection.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer.
_transfer reads contract and recipient balances via balanceOf.
_transfer swaps contract tokens for ETH through an external router call before finalizing transfer accounting.
_transfer forwards contract ETH to the fee wallet, invoking an external address mid-transfer.
_transfer reads and writes the cooldown mapping used for anti-whale throttling.
_transfer enforces the amount against _maxTxAmount.
_transfer enforces balance plus amount against _maxWalletSize.
_transfer requires that neither party is blacklisted in bots.
swapTokensForEth approves the router for tokenAmount before swapping.
swapTokensForEth makes the external router swap call that moves tokens out of the contract.
lockTheSwap toggles inSwap around the external swap call.
sendETHToFee performs a raw ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
The ETH transfer to the fee wallet can re-enter the contract through the payable receive hook.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract's ETH and token balance.
openTrading creates the trading pair via the factory.
openTrading stores the router instance in uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading flips tradingOpen, which permanently enables trading.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee via _reflectFee.
_takeTeam credits _rOwned of the contract address.
_reflectFee reduces the global _rTotal reflection supply.
_reflectFee increases the accumulated _tFeeTotal.
_reflectFee uses SafeMath sub/add on supply counters.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned balances.
_transferStandard uses SafeMath sub/add for balance updates.
_getValues obtains the current rate from _getRate.
_getValues computes token values via _getTValues.
_getValues computes reflection values via _getRValues.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads the mutable _rTotal.
_getCurrentSupply reads the constant _tTotal.
_getRate divides reflection supply by token supply with SafeMath.
changeMaxTxAmount writes the computed percentage into _maxTxAmount.
changeMaxWalletSize writes the computed percentage into _maxWalletSize.
removeLimits resets _maxTxAmount to the full supply.
removeLimits resets _maxWalletSize to the full supply.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldown enforcement flag.
changeMaxTxAmount performs mul/div on the supply.
changeMaxWalletSize performs mul/div on the supply.
recipient parameter feeds the transfer entry point.
amount parameter feeds the transfer entry point.
from parameter drives bot, cooldown and fee branch selection.
to parameter drives cooldown and wallet-size limit checks.
amount parameter is validated against _maxTxAmount.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped.
amount parameter is transferred to the fee wallet.
contractTokenBalance is passed as the swap input amount.
contractETHBalance is passed to sendETHToFee.
path array is supplied to the router swap call.
rAmount local is deducted from the sender's _rOwned balance.
rTransferAmount local is credited to the recipient's _rOwned balance.
rFee local flows into _reflectFee.
tTeam local flows into _takeTeam.
rSupply local is the numerator of the rate division.
tSupply local is the denominator of the rate division.
Loop index i indexes the blacklist array written into bots.
Local router instance is assigned to uniswapV2Router storage.

normalization_plan.reason: transfer.recipient is a transient parameter of the transfer function; fold into the transfer node.
transfer.amount is a transient parameter of the transfer function; fold into the transfer node.
transferFrom.sender is a transient parameter of transferFrom; fold into that function node.
transferFrom.recipient is a transient parameter of transferFrom; fold into that function node.
transferFrom.amount is a transient parameter of transferFrom; fold into that function node.
_transfer.from directly controls the bot/cooldown/fee branches in _transfer.
_transfer.to directly controls the limit and cooldown branches in _transfer.
_transfer.amount is validated inside _transfer against _maxTxAmount.
swapTokensForEth.tokenAmount is the sole input of the swap routine.
changeMaxTxAmount.percentage is the sole input used to size the new limit.
nonosquare.bots_ is the array iterated to update the bots mapping.
delBot.notbot is the address written into the bots mapping.
_transferStandard.tAmount is decomposed into all transfer accounting values.
_takeTeam.tTeam is the only input credited to the contract balance.
_reflectFee.rFee is subtracted from _rTotal inside _reflectFee.
_reflectFee.tFee is added to _tFeeTotal inside _reflectFee.
_getValues.tAmount is the input for all derived amounts.
_approve.owner is the allowance mapping key written by _approve.
_approve.spender is the allowance mapping key written by _approve.
_approve.amount is the value written into _allowances.
sendETHToFee.amount is forwarded directly to the fee wallet.
_getTValues.taxFee is the percentage used in the fee multiplication.
_getTValues.TeamFee is the percentage used in the team fee multiplication.
_getRValues.currentRate multiplies every token amount in _getRValues.
_transfer.contractTokenBalance is passed straight into swapTokensForEth.
_transfer.contractETHBalance is passed straight into sendETHToFee.
swapTokensForEth.path is consumed by the external router swap call.
_transferStandard.rAmount is deducted from the sender's reflection balance.
_transferStandard.rTransferAmount is credited to the recipient's reflection balance.
_transferStandard.rFee is forwarded to _reflectFee.
_transferStandard.tTransferAmount is emitted in the Transfer event.
_transferStandard.tFee is forwarded to _reflectFee.
_transferStandard.tTeam is forwarded to _takeTeam.
_takeTeam.currentRate scales the team token amount into reflections.
_getRate.rSupply is the numerator used by the rate division.
_getRate.tSupply is the denominator used by the rate division.
openTrading._uniswapV2Router is a temporary instance assigned to the router state variable.
nonosquare.i is the loop counter for the blacklist update.
